source = BUILD INSERT INTO wn.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject ; INSERT INTO gcide.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject ; INSERT INTO mw.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject ; INSERT INTO mwt.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject ; INSERT INTO moby.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject ; INSERT INTO map.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject ; INSERT INTO sqldoc.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject ; INSERT INTO measured.inbox ( word ) SELECT word FROM label WHERE gate = var subject BUILD BUILD INSERT INTO sheet ( run , name , value ) VALUES ( var run , 'dna' , 'g' || var subject ) BUILD BUILD INSERT INTO sheet ( run , name , value ) SELECT var run , 'def' , 'g' || trigger FROM var dna ORDER BY shard LIMIT 1 BUILD BUILD WITH r AS ( SELECT CAST ( value AS INTEGER ) AS rr , name AS src FROM sheet WHERE run = var run AND name IN ( 'wn' , 'gcide' , 'mw' , 'mwt' , 'moby' , 'map' , 'sqldoc' , 'measured' ) ) , g AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.rr , r.src , x.gate FROM r JOIN receipt x ON x.run = r.rr WHERE x.id > ( SELECT min ( y.id ) FROM receipt y WHERE y.run = r.rr AND y.gate = ( SELECT gate FROM label WHERE word = 'build' ) ) ) , df AS ( SELECT gate , 1.0 / count ( * ) AS w FROM g GROUP BY gate ) , pair AS ( SELECT a.rr AS ra , b.src AS sb , b.rr AS rb , sum ( df.w ) AS s FROM g a JOIN g b ON b.gate = a.gate AND b.src <> a.src JOIN df ON df.gate = a.gate GROUP BY a.rr , b.rr ) , best AS ( SELECT ra , sb , max ( s ) AS m FROM pair GROUP BY ra , sb ) , score AS ( SELECT ra , sum ( m ) AS sc FROM best GROUP BY ra ) INSERT INTO var def ( source , run , score ) SELECT ( SELECT gate FROM label WHERE word = r.src ) , r.rr , coalesce ( score.sc , 0 ) FROM r LEFT JOIN score ON score.ra = r.rr ORDER BY r.src IN ( 'wn' , 'gcide' , 'mw' ) DESC , coalesce ( score.sc , 0 ) DESC , r.rr BUILD
